questions.translation: 您可以隨時取消訂閱，不收任何費用。

questions.sentence: Over the years, the company has _____ large debts.
questions.translation: 這些年來，公司累積了大筆債務。
questions.explanation: has＋過去分詞是現在完成式。

questions.sentence: The company plans to _____ two smaller firms this year.
questions.translation: 公司計畫今年收購兩家小公司。
questions.explanation: plans to 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: The office building was _____ at five million dollars.
questions.translation: 這棟辦公大樓估價為五百萬美元。
questions.explanation: was＋過去分詞，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: The company will _____ laptops to all new employees.
questions.translation: 公司會提供筆電給所有新進員工。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: The company's accounts are _____ every year by an outside firm.
questions.translation: 公司的帳目每年由外部事務所查核。
questions.explanation: are＋過去分詞＋by，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: Government _____ on public transportation rose last year.
questions.translation: 去年政府在大眾運輸上的支出增加了。
questions.explanation: Government 後面接名詞當主詞，on 說明花在哪裡。

questions.sentence: Our products are now sold _____.
questions.translation: 我們的產品現在銷售到全世界。
questions.explanation: 句子已經完整，空格修飾動詞 are sold，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The _____ department handles all purchasing for the company.
questions.translation: 採購部負責公司所有的採購業務。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 The 後面接名詞，procurement department 是「採購部」。

questions.sentence: New _____ will require companies to report their emissions.
questions.translation: 新的法律將要求企業申報排放量。
questions.explanation: 形容詞 New 後面接名詞當主詞；legislator 是可數名詞，單數需要冠詞。

questions.sentence: The company is deeply committed to _____.
questions.translation: 公司非常致力於永續發展。
questions.explanation: be committed to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞。

questions.sentence: Full-time employees are _____ to fifteen days of paid leave.
questions.translation: 全職員工享有十五天的有薪假。
questions.explanation: are＋過去分詞，be entitled to 是「有權享有」。

questions.sentence: Approved travel expenses will be _____ within two weeks.
questions.translation: 核准的差旅費會在兩週內報銷。
questions.explanation: will be＋過去分詞，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: Please treat all customers _____.
questions.translation: 請以尊重的態度對待所有顧客。
questions.explanation: 句子已經完整，空格修飾動詞 treat，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: Department heads are held _____ for their team's results.
questions.translation: 部門主管要為團隊的成果負責。
questions.explanation: hold＋受詞＋形容詞，這裡是被動 are held＋形容詞；be held accountable for 是「被究責」。

questions.sentence: Please respond _____ to all customer emails.
questions.translation: 請迅速回覆所有顧客的電子郵件。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 respond，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The renovation will take a _____ amount of time.
questions.translation: 整修將花費相當多的時間。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a 後面、名詞 amount 前面要用形容詞。

questions.sentence: Rents have increased _____ since last year.
questions.translation: 租金從去年以來大幅上漲。
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 have increased，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The two products _____ each other very well.
questions.translation: 這兩項產品非常互補。
questions.explanation: 主詞 The two products 後面接動詞；複數主詞、現在式用原形。

questions.sentence: Online shopping is becoming more _____ among seniors.
questions.translation: 網路購物在長者之間越來越普遍。
questions.explanation: becoming more 後面接形容詞（比較級）。

questions.sentence: The new manual covers every safety topic _____.
questions.translation: 新手冊全面涵蓋了所有安全主題。
questions.explanation: 句子已經完整，空格修飾動詞 covers，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The hotel staff were _____ helpful during our stay.
questions.translation: 住宿期間，飯店員工格外熱心幫忙。
questions.explanation: 修飾形容詞 helpful，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The new booking system is very easy to _____.
questions.translation: 新的訂位系統非常容易管理。
questions.explanation: easy to 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: We will _____ confirm the date of the meeting by Friday.
questions.translation: 我們星期五前一定會確認會議日期。
questions.explanation: 夾在 will 和原形動詞 confirm 中間修飾動詞，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: The accident was caused by the driver's _____.
questions.translation: 這起意外是駕駛的疏忽造成的。
questions.explanation: 所有格 the driver's 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: The new schedule has been _____ approved, pending the CEO's signature.
questions.translation: 新的時程已經暫時核准，還要等執行長簽名。
questions.explanation: 夾在 has been 和過去分詞 approved 中間修飾動詞，要用副詞。

questions.sentence: Thank you for your _____ comments on the report.
questions.translation: 謝謝您對報告提出有見地的意見。
questions.explanation: 所有格 your 後面、名詞 comments 前面要用形容詞。

questions.sentence: Mr. Ng works for a large _____ company in Basel.
questions.translation: 吳先生在巴塞爾一家大型製藥公司工作。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a＋形容詞 large 後面、名詞 company 前面要用形容詞。

questions.sentence: Opening a second store was a major _____ for the family.
questions.translation: 開第二家店對這個家庭來說是一大成就。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a＋形容詞 major 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: Small businesses may apply for a tax _____.
questions.translation: 小型企業可以申請免稅。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a＋tax 後面要接名詞。

questions.sentence: Oil prices have _____ widely over the past year.
questions.translation: 過去一年油價大幅波動。
questions.explanation: have＋過去分詞是現在完成式。

questions.sentence: Ms. Kim will _____ the event with the hotel staff.
questions.translation: 金小姐會和飯店人員協調這場活動。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: Employees must not _____ confidential information to anyone.
questions.translation: 員工不得向任何人透露機密資訊。
questions.explanation: must not 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: Customer _____ of our brand has improved this year.
questions.translation: 今年顧客對我們品牌的觀感變好了。
questions.explanation: Customer 後面接名詞當主詞，後面有 of our brand。

questions.sentence: The storm damage will be _____ by an insurance agent.
questions.translation: 暴風雨造成的損害會由保險業務員評估。
questions.explanation: will be＋過去分詞＋by，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: This year's sales goal is challenging but _____.
questions.translation: 今年的業績目標有挑戰性，但可以達成。
questions.explanation: 和形容詞 challenging 並列，要用形容詞。

questions.sentence: All food companies must follow strict government _____.
questions.translation: 所有食品公司都必須遵守嚴格的政府法規。
questions.explanation: 形容詞 strict＋government 後面接名詞，當 follow 的受詞。

questions.sentence: The company is planning a major _____ of its sales department.
questions.translation: 公司正計畫大幅重整業務部門。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a＋形容詞 major 後面要接名詞；restructuring 是「重整」。

questions.sentence: The sales data was _____ from several different sources.
questions.translation: 這些銷售數據是從好幾個不同來源彙整的。
questions.explanation: was＋過去分詞，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: We must _____ our resources more efficiently.
questions.translation: 我們必須更有效率地運用資源。
questions.explanation: 助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞。

questions.sentence: The _____ of the two branch offices will save money.
questions.translation: 兩個分公司合併將能節省經費。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 The 後面、of 前面要用名詞。

questions.sentence: A professional _____ was hired to settle the dispute.
questions.translation: 公司請了一位專業調解人來解決糾紛。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 A＋形容詞 professional 後面接名詞當主詞，was hired 的是人。

questions.sentence: The product launch was very _____.
questions.translation: 產品發表會非常成功。
questions.explanation: very 後面接形容詞當補語。

questions.sentence: The travel guide is _____ with color photographs.
questions.translation: 這本旅遊指南附有彩色照片插圖。
questions.explanation: is＋過去分詞，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: The new cookware received an _____ from a famous chef.
questions.translation: 新廚具獲得一位知名主廚的推薦。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 an 後面接名詞，當 received 的受詞。

questions.sentence: The _____ of the lease takes effect on June 30.
questions.translation: 租約將在六月三十日終止。
questions.explanation: 冠詞 The 後面、of 前面要用名詞。

questions.sentence: Employee meals are _____ by the company.
questions.translation: 員工餐由公司補貼。
questions.explanation: are＋過去分詞＋by，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: Our website has been _____ for mobile users.
questions.translation: 我們的網站已經針對手機使用者最佳化。
questions.explanation: has been＋過去分詞，是被動語態。

questions.sentence: Smoking is allowed only in _____ areas.
questions.translation: 只有在指定區域才可以吸菸。
questions.explanation: 空格修飾名詞 areas，表示「被指定的」，要用過去分詞。
